chapter.verse: Ahihkeileh zong sanggamte aw, thukhun a theite' kianga thugen ka hih manin—thukhun in mi khat a nuntak laisiah bek uk thei ahihlam thei lo na hi uh hiam?
A hang pen pasal nei numei khat a pasal a nuntak laisiah thukhun in a pasal tawh khihkhawm a, ahi zongin a pasal a sih leh kitenna thukhun pan tua numei peng hi.

Tua dan mahin a pasal nungta lai pi-in pasal dang tawh a omkhop leh tua numei pen angkawm kici ding hi. Ahi zongin a pasal a sih leh tua thukhun pan amah peng a, pasal khat tawh a kiten leh zong amah angkawm hilo hi.

Tua mah bangin ka sanggamte aw, note pen midang khat ahi, misite' lakpan a kithokiksak Khris tawh kitengin Pasian' ading gahleteh na neih theih nadingun Khris pumpi hangin thukhun lamah a si khinzo na hi uh hi.
A hang pen cilesa tawh i nuntak hun lai-in thukhun' huhau-a piang mawhnopna lungsimte pen sihna gahleteh a piangsak dingin i pumpi nate' sungah gamtang uh hi.
Tu-in ahihleh hong khihcip thu lamah si i hih manin lai-a kigelh thukhun lui tawh ahilo, Kha paizia thak tawh a sem a bawl i hihtheih nadingin thukhun pan hong kikhahkhia ahi hi.

Tua hi a, bangci gen ding i hi hiam? Thukhun hoh mawhna ahi mai hiam? Hi peuhmah lo hi. Ahi zongin thukhun om lo hileh mawhna thu ka thei kei ding hi. A hang pen, “Na deihgawh kei ding hi,” ci-in thukhun in na gen lo hileh deihgawh a cih ka thei kei ding hi
Ahih hangin mawhna in thupiakna nuamtak sa-in ka sungah deihgawhna namcin piangsak hi. A hang pen thukhun om keileh mawhna zong a si ahi hi.
Kei pen thukhun lo tawh ka nungta ngei a, ahi zongin thupiakna hong pai ciangin mawhna hong nungta-in kei ka si hi.
Nuntak nading thupiakna pen kei' adingin sihna hong hizawsop hi.
A hang pen mawhna in thupiakna nuamtak sa-in kei hong khem a, tua tawh kei hong that hi.
Tua ahih manin thukhun pen siangtho a, thupiakna zong siangtho-in dikin hoih hi.

Tua ahihleh tua a hoih thu pen kei' adingin sihna a suak ahi hiam? Hi peuhmah lo hi. A hoih thu tungtawnin kei' sungah sihna a piangsak pen mawhna hi a, tua pen mawhna ahi bangbangin a kilatkhiat nading leh thupiakna hangin a siahuai mahmah a suah nading ahi hi.
Thukhun pen kha thu ahihlam i thei a, ahi zongin kei ka hihleh mawhna' khutnuai-a kizuak cilesa ka hi hi.
A hang pen ka ut ka sem kei a, ka huat mah bawl zawsop ka hih manin ka hih bang hiam cih zong ka kithei kei hi.
Tu-in ka utloh ka sep leh thukhun hoih hi ci-in a thukim ka hi hi.
Tua a sem pen kei hi nawnlo-in ka sunga om mawhna ahi hi.
A hang pen ka sungah, keima' cilesa sungah, a hoih khat zong om lo cih ka thei hi. A hang pen a hoih sep ding ka ut hangin a hoih ka sem zo kei hi.
Sep ding ka ut a hoih pen ka sem kei a, sep ding ka utloh a sia pen mah ka sem hi.
Tu-in ka utloh ka sep leh tua a sem pen kei hi nawnlo-in ka sunga om mawhna ahi hi.
Tua hangin a hoih sep ding ka ut ciangin thusia hong nai-om hi, cih thukhun khat ka mukhia hi.
A taktakin ka sungtawng panin Pasian' thukhun nuam ka sa hi.
Ahih hangin ka pumpi nate' sungah thukhun dang khat om ahihlam ka mukhia a, tua in keima' khuaphawkna thukhun lehdo-in ka pumpi nate sunga om mawhna thukhun ah kei hong awkcipsak hi.
Milunggim ka hita hi! Hih sihna pumpi pan kua in kei hong honkhia ding hiam?
Jesu Khris i Topa hangin Pasian' hehpihna ka phat hi. Tu-a teng ahih manin keimahmah in ka khuaphawkna tawh Pasian' thukhun ka zui a, ahi zongin ka cilesa tawh mawhna thukhun ka zui hi.
